description: Where each registry code came from: every phase-1 failure point (2026-09-23 survey), mapped to a registry code or excluded with a reason (defined in `exclusions`), plus `added`: codes no phase-1 point proposed, each with the date and why. scripts/add-code.mjs appends to `added`.

exclusions.no-fill: Ad no-fill / no-bid is not a failure. The existing adError / adNoBids / no-fill path covers it (rule 2).
exclusions.transport: Events transport code never reports itself (A7). Guard it in place instead.
exclusions.kill-switch: Intentional kill-switch drop (EVENTS_ENABLED). Not a failure.
exclusions.by-design: Expected behavior (feature off, consent, geo block, user or browser choice, graceful feature detection). Not a failure.
exclusions.log-once: Logged once by the lower layer that observes the failure (rule 2). This wrapper or caller must not log it again.
exclusions.tooling: Node build / deploy / CMS-server tooling. Not a clientFailure emitter: it has no events queue and runs in CI or Netlify. It fails through exit codes.
exclusions.known-drift: Cross-platform semantic drift that this program does not change (A9.2). Recorded in contracts/expectations/drift/<platform>.json.
exclusions.defect: Code defect to fix in place (escaping, leak, index math, cleanup, stale key). There is no runtime failure signal to log.
exclusions.in-page: Runs inside the WebView page, where the bridge itself is what failed. It cannot be reported from there.
exclusions.caller-abort: A caller-initiated abort is not a failure.
exclusions.privacy: A missing advertising id is a user or device privacy choice. Device-id state is never reported.
exclusions.lifecycle: Normal ad or view lifecycle (expiry, disposal). Not a failure.
exclusions.dead-code: Programmer-error path in dead code pending the delete decision.
exclusions.security: Security review item, not a runtime failure path.
exclusions.unreachable: The failure cannot happen on this platform: the call it guards never fails there (verified). The code stays for the platforms where it can.
